methodology.verdicts: MATCH | PARTIAL (same fact, different precision/wording/scope) | CONFLICT (different fact, both quoted) | MISSING (enriched 'unknown') | NOT_IN_GROUND_TRUTH (enriched value not covered by reference; not scored)
methodology.accuracy_pct: (MATCH + 0.5*PARTIAL) / (fields excluding NOT_IN_GROUND_TRUTH). MISSING is counted in the denominator even when the reference is also silent, because an 'unknown' is a coverage defect regardless of the reference.
methodology.aggregator_flag_count: number of enriched source_url occurrences (field-level + each funding round) whose domain is in the flag list
methodology.ground_truth: step-3 Perplexity-sourced sample supplied by the user; treated as reference, with its own inconsistencies flagged under ground_truth_inconsistencies
